## Description
<!-- What does this PR accomplish? -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] New feature (`feat:`)
- [ ] Bug fix (`fix:`)
- [ ] Asset update (`assets:`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs:`)
- [ ] Refactoring (`chore:`)
- [ ] Test addition (`test:`)

## Related Issue
Closes #(issue number)

## Testing
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] No console errors
- [ ] Builds successfully (`npm run build`)

## Code Quality
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run format` applied
- [ ] No breaking changes to existing APIs
- [ ] New public APIs documented

## Asset Changes (if applicable)
- File sizes checked: ✓
- Compression applied: ✓
- Git LFS tracked: ✓

## Systems Affected
<!-- Which game systems does this touch? -->
- [ ] Core (Engine, EventBus)
- [ ] Physics
- [ ] Input
- [ ] Rendering
- [ ] Gameplay / Rules
- [ ] Animation
- [ ] VFX
- [ ] UI
- [ ] Audio
- [ ] Other: ___

## Screenshots / Videos
<!-- If UI/visual changes, include media -->

## Checklist
- [ ] PR title follows convention (feat:, fix:, etc.)
- [ ] Commit messages are clear
- [ ] No debug code left in (`console.log`)
- [ ] Changes reviewed locally
- [ ] Ready for merge
